newsitem.title: UK: McDonnell has $365 million new plane orders.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell has $365 million new plane orders.

text.p: U.S. planemaker McDonnell Douglas Corp said on Monday it had six firm orders for new planes from four airline companies.
Mike Sears, president of the Douglas Aircraft Corp, told reporters at the Farnborough air show that the sales totalled $365 million.

Sears said the company had sold one MD90 and two options to Egyptian airline Heliopolis, three MD90s and three options to KTHY Airlines of Turkey, one MD11 to Vasp Brazilian Airlines, and one MD11 to an unnamed customer to be delivered in December.
The company has also completed negotiations with TWA for the sale of 13 of the MD80 family of aircraft, he said.
Ten of these are conversions of options announced in July for new MD83 aircraft.
The outstanding three aircraft are used MD82s, which will be delivered in December. The TWA deal is valued at $345 million.
